definitions.name: StateWellTyped
definitions.formula: StateWellTyped(sigma, Gamma) iff sigma is a finite record {accounts, debts, shares, fees, duties, requests, messages, orders, work, authority, historyIds, observations} and each field is well-typed in Gamma. accounts : FinMap(AccountId, FinMap(AssetId, Nat[0, M_a])). debts : FinMap(DebtId, {asset:AssetId, principal:Nat, accrued:Nat, debtor:AccountId, creditor:AccountId}). shares : FinMap(ShareId, {asset:AssetId, quantity:Nat, pool:PoolId}). fees : FinMap(FeeId, {asset:AssetId, amount:Nat, recipient:AccountId}). duties : FinMap(DutyId, {kind:DutyKind, amount:Nat, asset:AssetId, controller:AccountId, residual:Bool}). requests, messages, orders finite. work : {lifetime:Nat, spent:Nat, remainingOrdinary:Nat, remainingClosure:Nat} with spent+remainingOrdinary+remainingClosure=lifetime. authority : FinMap(PrincipalId, AllowedEffects). historyIds : FinSet(HistoryId). observations : FinSeq(Observation). No host heap.

definitions.name: expression-type
definitions.formula: Gamma |- e : tau is the proposed typing judgement on programs. tau in {Plan, Intent, Observation, EffectSet}. tau is not the type of a complete successor state sigma or sigma'. StateWellTyped is a separate judgement.

definitions.name: Eval
definitions.formula: Eval(profile, e, sigma) in {Prepared(sigma', pi), Reject(r)} is a proposed successor evaluator. This fragment does not implement Eval. profile is a proposed local oracle profile.

theorems.predicate: For every AssetId a, Sum_i post.accounts[i][a] - Sum_i pre.accounts[i][a] = minted(a) - burned(a). Internal transfers cancel. definitions.name: typed-asset-accounting-equation

definitions.name: debt-accounting
definitions.formula: CreateDebt(id,a,n) does not mint a. ReduceDebt(id,n) requires a Transfer of asset debt.asset with amount n, or n=0. RecognizeLossLabel does not change accounts or debt.principal. Capitalization (IPCI) may raise debt.principal with payoff 0. That principal change is not a token mint.

definitions.name: AllowedEffects-accounting-subset
definitions.formula: Accounting effects = {Transfer(from,to,a,n), Mint(a,n,to), Burn(a,n,from), AccrueFee(from,recipient,a,n)}. AccrueFee is a Transfer. Non-token effects = {CreateDebt, ReduceDebt, AssignDuty, RecognizeLossLabel, AdjustShareNAV, CreateRequest, Claim, Lock, Unlock}.

definitions.name: nominal-vs-movement
definitions.formula: ReduceDebt(id,n) without Transfer is forbidden unless n=0. Share quantity changes only with Mint/Burn of the share asset. Exact output is equality. Minimum output is inequality.

theorems.predicate: Every accepted effect e satisfies e in AllowedEffects(envelope). Delegation yields AllowedEffects(delegate) subseteq AllowedEffects(parent). Split, cancel, join, and migrate do not increase remainingOrdinary, remainingClosure, or AllowedEffects cardinality. CumulativeGross is monotone. Refunds do not increase remaining. Revoked or unknown semantics Reject with unchanged financial state.

definitions.name: AllowedEffects
definitions.formula: AllowedEffects(envelope) is the finite set of pairs (ctor, bound) signed in envelope. Constructors: Transfer, Mint, Burn, AccrueFee, CreateDebt, ReduceDebt, AssignDuty, RecognizeLossLabel, TradePortfolioAsset, PayFee, CancelResidual, Claim, Lock, Unlock, SendMessage, ReceiveMessage, RefundLock, WithdrawCash, RedeemOrdered, Swap, AddLiquidity, HookAdjustFee, WriteOff (authorized only). e in AllowedEffects iff e.ctor is present and e.amount <= bound(ctor, asset).

definitions.name: attenuation
definitions.formula: Delegate(parent, child, S) is valid iff S subseteq AllowedEffects(parent) and no ctor in {CreateDebt, GrantAuthority, ExternalRecipient} is added.

definitions.name: no-refresh
definitions.formula: On split of work W into W1, W2: W1.remainingOrdinary+W2.remainingOrdinary=W.remainingOrdinary and W1.remainingClosure+W2.remainingClosure=W.remainingClosure. AllowedEffects are partitioned, not copied. Cancel, join, and migrate obey the same sum, not a reset to envelope maxima.

definitions.name: compatibility
definitions.formula: Compat_sequential(A,B) iff producedHistories(A)=consumedHistories(B) and Auth_B subseteq residual(A). Compat_disjoint-parallel(A,B) iff FP_A.writes intersect FP_B.writes = empty and FP_A.writes intersect FP_B.reads = empty and FP_B.writes intersect FP_A.reads = empty and Auth_A intersect Auth_B = empty. Compat_shared-state-interleaving(A,B) iff there exists an explicit total order Ord on conflicting writes and both parties agree on Ord. Compat_atomic-synchronization(A,B) iff there is a joint envelope E with AllowedEffects(E)=AllowedEffects(A) union AllowedEffects(B) and no external observable prefix of a proper subset of legs. Compat_asynchronous-messaging(A,B) iff the message alphabet, timeout tick, lock amount, refund amount, and provenance IDs are named in OpAsm(async).

definitions.name: guarantee-derivation
definitions.formula: G_sequential(GA,GB)=GA then GB on the concatenated history. G_disjoint-parallel(GA,GB)=GA and GB on the pair of histories. G_shared-state-interleaving(GA,GB)=the ordered composition along Ord, not GA and GB unordered. G_atomic-synchronization(GA,GB)=GA and GB on the joint post-state or else Reject all. G_asynchronous-messaging(GA,GB)=GA on send/lock and GB on receive-or-refund, never both credit and refund.

definitions.name: OpAsm

definitions.name: observation-equivalence
definitions.formula: ObsEq(o1,o2) iff there exists an alpha-renaming rho such that rho(o1.accounts, o1.transfers, o1.debts, o1.duties, o1.requests, o1.messages, o1.fees, o1.work.spent) equals the corresponding fields of o2, ignoring bound names in Bindable={historyId, requestId, messageId, dutyId, claimId, stateId}. Pool reserves, LP supply, and named account balances are free names and must match.

definitions.name: alpha-renaming
definitions.formula: An alpha-renaming is a bijection rho : Bindable -> Bindable that is identity on free names (account ids in the pre-state, asset ids, signed principals). Substitution is capture-avoiding on bound history names.

definitions.name: observation-order
definitions.formula: OrderCond_sequential: observations concatenate. OrderCond_disjoint-parallel: observations of the two sides form a bag; no cross order. OrderCond_shared: the explicit serialization Ord is part of the observation; commuting Ord is not ObsEq. OrderCond_atomic: the only observations are pre and post of the joint envelope. OrderCond_async: Created < Pending < {Finalized, Refundable}; Finalized and Refunded are exclusive.

definitions.name: associativity-conditions
definitions.formula: sequential and disjoint-parallel: ObsEq of the two binary groupings. shared-state: only if Ord is identical. atomic: only if the joint envelope set is the same. async: not associative, because lock/deadline/refund order is not a binary algebra on components.

theorems.predicate: DutyConserv(pre, post, effects) holds for every accepted transition. Work exhaustion, cancel, and migrate do not delete duties. Expiry does not delete debt. Pending request/controllers survive partial progress.

definitions.name: duty-conservation
definitions.formula: Let Out(sigma) be DutyId -> Duty of sigma.duties with residual=true. DutyConserv iff Out(post)=(Out(pre) minus Discharged) union Created, Discharged intersect Created = empty, and every d in Discharged has an effect in {SettleTransfer matching d.asset and d.amount, WriteOff(d) with ctor WriteOff in AllowedEffects, Novation(d,d') with d' in Created and exact-once assignment}. RecognizeLossLabel is not a discharge. CancelResidual discharges cancel-rights, not payment duties. Successor assignment requires identified S with S.remainingClosure >= minClosure 16 and no duplication of remainingOrdinary.

definitions.name: closure-reserve
